name: ExportPanel - With Snapshot History
description: The backup half with a real undo stack: the current groups on top, then every prior shape of the set beneath. Every snapshot here — current and previous alike — carries its own Copy button, in the same row position, so taking a backup is one click from whichever one the user actually needs. That the Previous stack exists at all is what makes the page a recovery tool rather than a backup button: when a sync warning appears, the user often needs the snapshot from BEFORE whatever went wrong, not the current one.
